name: Isooctyl palmitate
description: Isooctyl palmitate (CAS 1341-38-4 ), also known commercially as palmitic acid 2-ethylhexyl ester, is a synthetic ester of palmitic acid used as an emollient, solvent, and carrier in cosmetic and pharmaceutical formulations. It provides skin-conditioning and spreading properties without the heaviness associated with natural oils. In personal care, it functions as a lightweight emollient in lotions, creams, and sunscreens, improving skin feel and spreadability. This versatile ester helps in reducing greasiness in various topical applications. Pharmaceutical topical formulations use it as a carrier solvent to enhance the delivery and dispersion of active ingredients across the skin barrier effectively. Color cosmetics such as lipsticks and foundations incorporate it as a plasticizer and binder to improve texture and application consistency. It also serves as a solubilizer for oil-soluble actives and pigments in product formats. The material is effective in both rinse-off and leave-on product formats for diverse consumer needs. Isooctyl palmitate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid suitable for direct incorporation into many different formulations. It is available in cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications to meet the purity requirements of regulated end products. Bulk supply is standard in drums and intermediate bulk containers for industrial logistics. Technical-grade material is also available for non-cosmetic industrial applications requiring high performance.
